name: Infinity Water Bucket
summary: Lets the Infinity enchantment be applied to water buckets and empty buckets with an anvil. An infinite water bucket never runs out; an enchanted empty bucket acts as an infinite liquid void. Config can extend this to lava, milk and powdered snow buckets.

new_content.name: Infinity enchantment on buckets
new_content.how_to_obtain: Combine a bucket or water bucket with an Infinity book in an anvil
new_content.notes: Also works with dispensers and cauldrons (infinite fill/consume). Enchanted empty buckets cannot milk cows or pick up fish/axolotls.

vanilla_changes.change: Now applicable to water buckets and empty buckets (config options extend this to lava, milk and powdered snow buckets).

editor_notes: allstackable gives buckets stack size 64 (lava/milk 16, per config-overrides); interplay with infinite buckets untested. Lava/milk/snow options not overridden by pack (assume default off). Server-side, but missing on client may cause visual glitches. Check whether pack changes Infinity availability.
